name: Dramatic Deep Dive
description: Full-Kanto Deep Dive 0.6 with animated Pokemon Stadium 2 underwater wildlife, free-depth swimming, expanded Kanto seabeds, visible-only Wilds encounters, salvage and HM08 DIVE. Supports modern Battle Art/Dramaless providers plus an official legacy Dramatic Shape path; Dramatic Shape + Pokemon Stadium Overworld Models delegates underwater Pokemon rendering to the existing Stadium renderer to avoid double VoxelScene ownership.
